The root compose.yml is a deployment example; keep its image reference floating rather than digest-pinned
Don't pin CentOS Stream, old digests aren't retained after updates

The chart is validated against both Helm majors in ci.yml's chart matrix and packaged by one of them in helm-chart.yml; dev:check (verifyChartPins) refuses a packaging pin the matrix does not list, so the matrix leg and the packaging pin have to arrive together. Renovate's default branch topic already co-locates them (same depName, same newMajor); grouping per major states that requirement instead of inheriting it. The major must stay in the group name — a bare 'Helm' collapses both legs into one branch, which is the coupling ci.yml's fail-fast: false exists to avoid

Never offer to move a Helm pin across a major. Each matrix leg exists to cover the major it names, so a major update proposes deleting that coverage rather than refreshing it, and it would collide with the other leg's own patch update in the same group. Adding or retiring a major is a hand edit to the matrix
Allow Renovate to bump the 'go' directive in go.mod
